description: Source code implementing gRPC client stream functionality, including stream management, reading, writing, and header handling.

classes.name: ClientStream
classes.description: Implements streaming functionality for a gRPC client, managing stream state, headers, and data transfer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a message of specified size from the stream.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream and propagates an error to readers.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes header and data bytes to the output stream.

methods.name: BytesReceived
methods.description: Indicates if any bytes have been received on the stream.

methods.name: Unprocessed
methods.description: Indicates if the server did not process this stream.

methods.name: waitOnHeader
methods.description: Waits for header metadata to be available or stream cancellation.

methods.name: RecvCompress
methods.description: Returns the compression algorithm applied to inbound messages.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Returns a channel that signals when the stream has ended.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns the header metadata of the stream.

methods.name: TrailersOnly
methods.description: Checks if the stream was trailers-only.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the status received from the server.
